![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

When validating assertions and source spans, use defensive guards to ensure that the assertion and span elements are valid objects before dereferencing their properties. This prevents potential `TypeError` exceptions if the input data contains nullish or malformed elements.

```suggestion
  return Array.isArray(pack?.assertions) && pack.assertions.every((assertion) => (
    isObject(assertion?.evidence_bundle) &&
    Array.isArray(assertion.evidence_bundle.evidence_refs) &&
    assertion.evidence_bundle.evidence_refs.length > 0 &&
    Array.isArray(assertion.source_spans) &&
    assertion.source_spans.length > 0 &&
    assertion.source_spans.every((span) => hasString(span?.artifact_path) && hasString(span?.pointer))
  ));
```
